basic_details.short_information: The Panjab University (PU) has officially announced the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://puchd.ac.in. Candidates holding a postgraduate degree in Life Sciences and Law Studies are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 13 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and view the walk-in interview details are shared below.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post at Panjab University?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at Panjab University is scheduled for 13 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-graduate degree in Life Sciences and Law Studies to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at Panjab University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is Rs.37,000/- p.m. + Annual contingency or Rs.28,000/- p.m. + Annual contingency of Rs 25000/- plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at Panjab University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to appear directly for the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Office of the DPIIT-IPR Chair, 3rd Floor, Guru Teg Bahadur Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their duly filled application form, one recent passport-size photograph, original certificates, and one set of self-attested photocopies of all educational qualifications, experience certificates, fellowship certificates (JRF/NET, if applicable), publications, and any other relevant supporting documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at least 30 minutes before the scheduled interview time for verification of documents. The interview is scheduled between 11:15 AM and 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit specified for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any specific age criteria or relaxation details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The job for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is temporary.
